hero.headline: A quiet studio space for learning, creating, and building.
hero.text: Static Garden is a full-production audio and video studio for artists and content creators. It brings learning, production, and technical support into one working environment built to help ideas take shape.

learn.headline: Learn
learn.text: Static Garden also functions as a learning space. Programs cover groove, musicianship, writing, getting started, gear, podcasting, video editing, and more through free archives and one-on-one support.

create.headline: Create
create.text: Creation sits at the center of the studio. Clients work with capable tools, practical guidance, and room to develop ideas into finished work with structure and direction.

build.headline: Build
build.text: Beyond making the work, there is the system around it. Static Garden supports promotion, organization, websites, integrations, maintenance, and troubleshooting so the project can keep moving.

studio.headline: The Studio
studio.text: At its core, Static Garden Studio is a cozy but capable private workshop focused on audio and video post-production. It blends analog and digital tools in a warm environment designed for generating ideas.

about.headline: Static Garden
about.text: Static Garden is the parent studio and umbrella brand connecting three distinct lanes: Power Chord Theory, Twirl Tape Productions, and Plain Text Support. It exists as a real creative environment where people can learn, create, and build around their work.

projects.headline: Learn, Create, Build
projects.text: Static Garden supports people through coaching, production, recording, and the systems that help finished work reach the right audience.

contact.headline: Contact
contact.text: Use contact as a routing point for the studio and each connected lane.
